units.source_text: 秋好皇后的庭前，今年种的秋花比往年更加出色。

en.t: In front of Empress Akikonomu's garden, the autumn flowers planted this year were more splendid than in other years.

units.source_text: 各种秋花都齐备，处处设有雅致的篱垣，

en.t: Every kind of autumn flower was there, and elegant fences had been set up here and there,

units.source_text: 有的用带皮枝条修成，有的用剥皮枝条修成。

en.t: some made from branches with the bark left on, and others from branches stripped clean.

units.source_text: 同是一种花，这里的特别鲜妍：

en.t: Even when they were the same kind of flower, the ones here were especially fresh and brilliant:

units.source_text: 枝条的形状、花的姿态，以及朝夕带露时的光彩，

en.t: the shape of the branches, the bearing of the blossoms, and the glow they had when touched with dew morning and evening

units.source_text: 都与寻常不同，像珠玉一般辉煌。

en.t: were all unlike ordinary flowers, shining like jewels and pearls.

units.source_text: 看了这片人造的秋野的景色，

en.t: When one looked at the scenery of this man-made autumn field,

units.source_text: 又教人忘记了春山之美，但觉凉爽快适，神往心移。

en.t: it even made one forget the beauty of spring hills, leaving only a cool, pleasant feeling that drew the heart away.

units.source_text: 讲到春秋优劣之争论，自昔赞美秋景之人居多。

en.t: When it came to the debate over whether spring or autumn was superior, from ancient times more people had praised autumn scenery.

units.source_text: 因此从前颂扬紫姬园中有名的春花那班人，

en.t: Therefore, the very people who had once praised the famous spring flowers in Lady Murasaki's garden

units.source_text: 现在又回过头来称道秋好皇后的秋院了。

en.t: now turned around and began praising Empress Akikonomu's autumn garden.

units.source_text: 这正与世态炎凉相似。

en.t: This was just like the fickleness of the world.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后归宁在家，欣赏这秋院美景之时，

en.t: While Empress Akikonomu was at home on a visit to her family and was admiring the beauty of this autumn garden,

units.source_text: 颇思举行管弦之会。

en.t: she very much wished to hold a gathering of music.

units.source_text: 但八月是她的父亲已故前皇太子的忌月，不宜作乐。

en.t: But the eighth month was the memorial month for her father, the late former crown prince, so it was not proper to make music.

units.source_text: 她深恐花期过时，便朝朝暮暮赏玩这些日益繁茂的秋花。

en.t: Deeply afraid that the flowering season would pass, she admired these ever more luxuriant autumn flowers morning and evening.

units.source_text: 不料天色大变，朔风忽起，今年比往年更加猛烈，

en.t: Unexpectedly, the sky changed completely and a north wind suddenly rose, fiercer this year than in other years,

units.source_text: 各种好花都被吹得枯落。

en.t: and all the fine flowers were blown until they withered and fell.

units.source_text: 连不甚爱花的人，也都惊叫：“啊呀，不得了啊！”

en.t: Even people who did not care much for flowers cried out in alarm, "Oh no, this is terrible!"

units.source_text: 何况秋好皇后。

en.t: How much more so, then, for Empress Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 她看见草上之露像碎玉一般零落，

en.t: She saw the dew on the grass scatter like shattered jewels,

units.source_text: 觉得伤心惨目，恨不得像古歌中所咏的，

en.t: and found it so heartbreaking that she wished, as an old poem had sung,

units.source_text: 用一只宽大的衣袖来遮住了秋空的朔风。

en.t: that she could block the north wind in the autumn sky with one broad sleeve.

units.source_text: 天色渐暮，四周昏暗，不见一物。

en.t: The day gradually darkened, the surroundings grew dim, and nothing could be seen.

units.source_text: 朔风越来越紧，气象阴森可怕。

en.t: The north wind grew stronger and stronger, and the atmosphere became gloomy and frightening.

units.source_text: 格子窗都已关闭，秋好皇后笼闭一室，

en.t: The lattice shutters had all been closed, and Empress Akikonomu shut herself inside one room,

units.source_text: 心中只是挂念庭中的秋花，独自悲伤叹息。

en.t: thinking only of the autumn flowers in the garden as she grieved and sighed alone.
